title: Oldest securely dated rock art (hand stencil)
place: Liang Metanduno, Muna Island, Sulawesi, Indonesia
summary: A hand stencil on a cave wall is the oldest securely dated rock art.
why: Shows cave art in Asia at least as old as any securely dated in Europe.

notes.problem: Title drops 'securely'; why 'cave art began in Asia' goes beyond the source ('oldest securely dated ... reported to date').

superlativeSource: provides the oldest securely dated evidence of rock art reported to date
